B5 · Add a reminder by typing

For when you’re already looking at the list and think of one more. No voice, no review, three taps after typing.

B5 · 1+ Add opens a sheet with the keyboard up.Tony, 30 Sep: “When I’m looking at reminders, I might think of another one… I can just type out, like, pick up Presley. And then I just set the date, time, and send it.” The field is focused, so you type first. It starts on Me, today, any time: typing and hitting return is already a reminder. The mic in the field switches to voice for anyone who’d rather talk.

B6 · When voice doesn’t give us a reminder

One real error screen, for when there’s nothing to work with. Everything else is a gap we fill and mark, not an error.

B6 · 1Heard something, but not a reminder.Mohit asked for this one: the parent talked, but there’s nothing to remind anyone about (“what’s the weather like”, or the TV). We don’t show what we heard, same reason there’s no live transcript. We show the sentence that works, and two ways forward: Try again goes straight back to listening, Type it instead opens the B5 sheet.

If we got what but not when, go to Review as usual with the gap marked: Today, any time is filled in so Set reminder still works, and the amber box asks you to check it. No one gets sent back to talk again for something one tap fixes.

B7 · One brief for two parents: three directions

For tomorrow’s working session with Tony. The same moment in each: Dana has said yes to Lydia’s Fall Festival invitation, and this is Tony’s phone. Tony: “We don’t have that fully fleshed out.” So these are options to pick from, not a decision.

Direction AQuietestAnswered for the family. It just leaves.Dana taps Yes on Lydia’s Fall Festival invitation, for the family. On Tony’s phone it’s no longer an invitation: it’s in Upcoming with Going and Dana’s photo. Tony: “I don’t also need to answer that invitation. It should kind of go away.” Jake’s pickleball invite was only for Tony, so it waits for him.
Risk: Tony never sees that it happened unless he reads Upcoming. Fine if he trusts Dana’s answer; a surprise if he had other plans that Saturday.
